import pandas as pd

def parse_money(values):
    cleaned = (values.astype("string").str.strip()
               .str.replace("$", "", regex=False).str.replace(",", "", regex=False))
    return pd.to_numeric(cleaned, errors="coerce")


def clean_orders(path):
    """Return the messy export cleaned and deduplicated."""
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["customer"] = df["customer"].str.strip()
    df["country"] = df["country"].str.strip().str.title()
    df["channel"] = df["channel"].str.replace(" ", "_").fillna("unknown")
    df["total"] = parse_money(df["total"])
    df["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["order_date"], format="mixed", dayfirst=True)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    assert df["order_id"].is_unique, "duplicate order ids remain"
    return df


clean = clean_orders("orders_messy.csv")

sales_by_country = {}
for country in clean["country"].unique():
    sales_by_country[country] = round(float(clean.loc[clean["country"] == country, "total"].sum()), 2)
print(sales_by_country)
